# The Usual Suspects

> IncidentLens is a local demonstration that groups synthetic IT incidents and presents evidence for human review.

- The application uses generated sample records only.
- Root-cause scores are heuristic evidence scores, not probabilities.
- Human review is required before creating a problem record.
- The source repository is available at https://github.com/BradleyWPL/The-Usual-Suspects.
- The local demo is not an authenticated production service and must not receive private incident data.
